name: Say Uncle
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from Kitty Mulligan's Irish Pub (Bay Shore) - events. Check the name and add a website or social page.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Website is a free Wix subdomain (grobber1101.wixsite.com/sayuncleband-li); the older Weebly site still exists and points to it. Facebook is a profile-style page id (no vanity name). Instagram handle on the site is 'SayUncle5' (written in lowercase here). A second YouTube channel '@sayunclebandli4236' has older 2019 gig videos; the site links @SayUncle-br8vh. Skipped a site photo that shows party guests up close. Not the same as 'Say Uncle!' on Apple Music (folk/indie album 'Scattered Seeds').
description: Six-piece Long Island cover band, many of them family members, that plays popular rock and pop covers for dancing at bars and parties, from classic rock to 2000s hits like Matchbox 20, Foo Fighters and The Killers.
